idea-plugin.name: Structure Diff
idea-plugin.description:
Review what AI coding agents changed – Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, DeepSeek, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and others. Shows changes at member level: added, modified and removed classes, methods and fields of each changed file, in a tree like the Structure tool window, and shows AI code-review findings (SARIF) right in the editor.

Works for every language with a Structure view (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, JavaScript, ...) and refreshes automatically.

Structure Diff tool window

  • Modes: Uncommitted changes; Branch vs main – everything the branch changed since it forked from main/master, like a merge request (needs Git); Follow Git Log – the commits selected in the Git log.
  • Export Diff for Review – saves the changes to reviews/<timestamp>-changes.diff and copies a review skill command to paste into your AI agent. With changes in several repositories, the selected one is exported alone; otherwise each gets a <timestamp>-<repo>-changes.diff and the command lists them all. The directory and the command are set in Settings | Tools | Structure Diff.
  • Toggles: Show Nested Changes (inside functions and object literals), Show Unversioned Files (except files directly in the repository root), Flash Changes (briefly highlight what appeared, changed or disappeared).
  • Per file and member: + added, ~ modified, − removed counts, changed lines, renames/moves, and old vs new signature in the tooltip. Multiple VCS roots are grouped.
  • Double-click/Enter jumps to source, middle-click opens the diff at the member; context menu: Show Diff, Jump to Source, Copy Path.

Review Findings

  • When a reviews/*.sarif file appears, or you open a SARIF file from elsewhere with Open Review, its findings are highlighted in the editor with a gutter icon; the tooltip shows the finding and suggested fix.
  • The Review Findings tool window lists them by file and severity; double-click or Enter jumps to the code. Open an older review, Reload, or Clear All.
  • Findings follow your edits; when the code is gone they are greyed as possibly fixed.
  • Dismiss, Restore and Copy findings; dismissed ones stay dismissed in later reviews.
  • The Structure Diff tree marks members and files that have findings (⚠N).
